Title: Continuous Language ID in Azure Speech Service

Body.Content:
Continuous Language ID is now available with Azure Speech Services. This real-time language detection feature can detect up to 10 languages continuously, making it easier to transcribe and translate audio content with multiple languages.
 

Get started with Continuous Lanugage ID.

Continuous Language ID is building off existing Language ID capabilities.
